decks.notes: This Orzhov control deck focuses on using a variety of removal spells and disruptive cards to control the opponent's board and hand, while establishing a strong board presence with powerful creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Silverquill Silencer. The deck also includes cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Wedding Announcement to generate card advantage and gain incremental value over time. By utilizing a mix of removal, disruption, and card advantage tools, this deck aims to outlast opponents and grind out victories in longer games.

Emphasis on controlling the game through a mixture of removal, counter spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to stall opponents with removal spells like Fading Hope and Dragon's Fire, while generating card advantage with Expressive Iteration and Unexpected Windfall. By using powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon and Hall of Storm Giants, the deck can quickly close out the game once it has gained control. The mana base is focused on consistency, with pathways and dual lands to ensure smooth mana development. Smoldering Egg provides an alternate win condition if needed.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments. By utilizing cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Rune of Might, the deck can quickly build a threatening board presence. The inclusion of Kami of Transience and Generous Visitor provides additional support and resilience against removal spells. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure consistently throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on using a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. It utilizes a combination of efficient creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Elite Spellbinder, along with removal spells like Vanishing Verse and Bloodchief's Thirst to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Sorin the Mirthless and powerful finishers like The Meathook Massacre and Lolth, Spider Queen provides additional threats and versatility to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their strategy with cards like Elite Spellbinder and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain it throughout, using cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to create a constant threat on the battlefield. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruption spells, this deck aims to end the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with counters like Jwari Disruption and removal spells like Dragon's Fire, the player aims to survive until they can drop powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon. Expressive Iteration and Seize the Spoils provide card advantage while also helping to filter through the deck. The deck also includes some protection and flexibility with cards like Sejiri Shelter and Valorous Stance. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through careful resource management.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and removal spells. The deck aims to establish board control using cards like Negate and Disdainful Stroke, while also drawing cards and maintaining card advantage with Behold the Multiverse and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes win conditions like Emeria's Call and The Wandering Emperor, and utilizes lands like Field of Ruin and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire for additional utility. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through careful resource management and control.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of powerful white creatures that have low mana costs and aggressive abilities. By playing multiple creatures each turn and using cards like Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to maintain pressure and keep the opponent on the back foot. Cards like Valorous Stance provide protection for key creatures, while land cards like Crawling Barrens and Cave of the Frost Dragon offer additional late-game options for securing victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using removal spells like Vanishing Verse and The Wandering Emperor, while also utilizing cards like Deadly Dispute and The Meathook Massacre to maintain board presence. Kaito Shizuki and Wedding Announcement provide additional utility, while Rite of Oblivion serves as a powerful tool for dealing with threats. The creatures in the deck, such as Malevolent Hermit and Spirited Companion, help to establish a strong board presence when needed. The mana base includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency in casting spells and activating abilities.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and tempo through cards like Prismari Command, Galvanic Iteration, and Unexpected Windfall. The deck combines removal spells, counterspells, and card selection tools to outvalue the opponent and protect powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon. The mana base is also carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all three colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's pace and win through incremental advantage and efficient resource management.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing powerful creature cards such as Old-Growth Troll, Werewolf Pack Leader, and Primal Adversary to overwhelm opponents quickly. With support from cards like Esika's Chariot and Invoke the Ancients, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and apply pressure. Additionally, the inclusion of removal spells like Blizzard Brawl and Ranger Class helps to clear the way for the creatures to deal damage efficiently. The deck also features land cards like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide additional utility and flexibility in different situations.

This deck focuses on building a board presence quickly and aggressively, with a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful spells to overwhelm the opponent. The main strategy is to play efficient creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Elite Spellbinder, and Luminarch Aspirant early on, followed by impactful spells like Showdown of the Skalds to keep the pressure up. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Valorous Stance and Brutal Cathar provide removal options. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure a smooth curve and consistent access to all colors.

The main concept of this Naya Aggro deck is to quickly build up a board presence with aggressive creatures like Runeforge Champion and Kami of Transience, while using powerful enchantments like Showdown of the Skalds and Runes to buff them up and overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to win the game swiftly by attacking relentlessly and leveraging the versatility of cards like Generous Visitor and Commune with Spirits. Additionally, the inclusion of lands like Needleverge Pathway and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to support the aggressive strategy and ensure consistent mana production.

This deck focuses on using counter spells, removal, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to stall the game until it can establish a strong board presence with powerful threats like Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset and Hullbreaker Horror. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the inclusion of land destruction like Field of Ruin helps disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes lifegain and graveyard hate to further control the match and prevent the opponent from gaining too much advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost, efficient creatures that can put pressure on the opponent early in the game. By utilizing cards that boost the power and toughness of creatures, as well as disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards such as Elite Spellbinder, the deck aims to maintain a strong offense while also providing some defense. The inclusion of cards like Reidane, God of the Worthy and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben also helps to slow down the opponent's spells, giving the deck an advantage in the early game.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures and disrupting their strategy with cards like Elite Spellbinder. It also utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down the opponent's plays. The deck also includes some removal spells like Fateful Absence and Valorous Stance to deal with threats. Reidane, God of the Worthy helps to stop the opponent's spells and abilities, while cards like Legion Angel provide additional threats and card advantage. The deck aims to be aggressive and apply pressure early on in the game.
